question: What claim about measure requires this Kaula teaching to be designated as supremely arisen and as measuring ten crores?
premises: It is designated as supremely arisen.
Its measure is said to be ten crores.
inference: This Kaula teaching, supremely arisen, is of the measure of ten crores.
plain_english: Indeed, this Kaula teaching, supremely arisen, is of the measure of ten crores.
